title: SBM Paisabazaar Step - Up Mastercard (FD) credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: SBM (State Bank of Mauritius) has partnered with Paisabazaar (Mastercard) to provide customers with access to a wide range of financial products and services. This collaboration allows SBM users to explore and apply for credit cards, loans, and other financial offerings through the Paisabazaar platform, leveraging the global reach and security of Mastercard.
